note: OSV lists no fix commit; the fix is f5da73e6fc in 4.1.135 ("Enforce max concurrent streams for misbehaving clients"), which applies the advertised limit in the handler builder. Without it, DefaultEndpoint.createStream opens streams with no cap. Present in 4.1.42, 4.1.100, 4.1.131 and 4.2.6, and under the io.grpc.netty.shaded prefix in grpc-netty-shaded 1.50.0 and 1.70.0. Any HTTP/2 server built on Netty reaches it.
